reviews.body:
APPROVE

The change aligns the three option-schema validators with the `CatalogProductOptionSchema` type, which already declares `name`/`description` as `string | null`, and with the existing `.nullable().optional()` treatment of the sibling description fields. `normalizeCatalogOptionSchema` is null-safe (a null name is dropped, a null option description is stored as null), so the widened input cannot corrupt the persisted JSONB. Omitting a field still stays omitted, trimming and length bounds are intact, and the new unit test covers acceptance, null-vs-omitted, trimming and the rejection paths.

No findings. No migration, API-shape or locale work is needed for this input widening.

Validation source: no workflow checks are reported for head `3928ad8` beyond `label` and `license/cla`; per the operator instruction this review is code-level only and does not gate on CI status. The author reports the new unit test passing 12/12 and the four null cases failing on `main`.
